plot: On Dog's birthday at sunset Max is made Chief Cake Sharer, but his straight stripes give Mouse a crumb and someone a giant middle piece, so he finds that every piece must touch the candle and cuts five petal-shaped pieces; then a knock reveals Dog's secret wish, his park friend Pepper, and instead of re-cutting, everyone gives Pepper one bite so her piece is made of everybody.

script.title: 1 Birthday Cake, 5 Plates... Then a Knock!

beats.say: Whoa! Catch the cake! Don't let it fall!
My birthday cake! Max, you saved it!
Phew. Now, how do we share one cake fairly?
It's Dog's birthday, and the sun is going down.
Grandma baked a round strawberry cake with one candle.
Max, you are the Chief Cake Sharer today.
Your job: every piece exactly the same.
Chief Cake Sharer! The most important job in the house!
Just remember, I'm small. But my tummy is not.
Count everybody! And one plate for my... um... never mind.
For your what, Dog?
For my... tail! My tail gets hungry too. Ha ha!
Okay. Me, Dog, Mouse, Grandma... and Bird. Five friends.
I'm here! I'm here! Did somebody say cake?
Five pieces, Grandma. All the same.
Max looks at the cake. He holds his paw like a knife.
Cut here. And here. And here. Nice straight lines!
Grandma makes little marks across the cake. Five long stripes.
A round cake is wide in the middle, thin at the ends.
Max... my stripe is a crumb with a line of cream.
Mine is all crust! Where's my strawberry?
And the middle stripe is as big as my head!
Everybody looks at the giant middle piece. Then at Max.
Uh-oh. Stripes are not fair on a round cake.
Good thing I only made little marks. We can still fix it.
Candle time is in ten minutes! I need a better plan!
Max walks around the cake. Once. Twice. Three times.
From above, the cake is a circle. The candle is the middle.
The candle! Every piece should touch the candle!
Pointy in the middle, round at the edge. Like a pizza!
Yes! Then everybody gets middle and edge and strawberry!
Grandma smooths the marks away with her spoon. A fresh start.
But five is a tricky number. How do I go around?
Like my paw! Four toes and one thumb. Five!
Max taps five spots around the cake, like a flower's petals.
Grandma cuts from each spot to the candle. Swish, swish, swish.
Five pieces, Max. Pointy in the middle, round at the edge.
All the same size! I measured them with my wing!
And mine has a whole strawberry! Chief Cake Sharer, you did it!
Five friends, five pieces. Nobody gets a crumb!
Well done, Chief. Fair and square. Or fair and round!
My nose says strawberry. My tummy says hurry!
Grandma lights the candle. Everybody starts to sing.
Happy birthday, dear Dog! Happy birthday to you!
I wish... I wish... I can't say it. It's a secret!
Dog blows. Whoosh! The candle goes out.
And then... knock, knock, knock. At the front door.
She came! My wish came true! It's Pepper from the park!
Hi! Happy birthday, Dog! Am I too late?
I invited her yesterday. She was my secret plate!
Six friends?! But I only have five pieces!
Somebody gets nothing! On a birthday!
Oh. It's okay. I don't need cake. I can just watch.
No! Nobody just watches at my party. Everybody eats!
Should I cut all the pieces again, Max?
No. They're perfect. Cutting again makes a cake mess.
Max looks at his own piece. Then at Pepper's empty plate.
I know! Everybody gives Pepper one little bite!
Max puts the first bite from his piece on Pepper's plate.
Here's my strawberry bite!
And my crusty bite, with extra cream!
And one big Grandma bite.
And the birthday bite. The biggest one of all!
Five little bites make one whole piece for Pepper!
A piece made of everybody! That's the best piece ever!
And I brought you a present, Dog. A brand new ball!
A ball! Now my party has everything!
Six friends, six pieces. And the sharing was the sweetest part!
Sharing isn't about the biggest piece. It's about leaving nobody out.
Best birthday ever! Can we have another one tomorrow?
Birthdays come once a year, Dog. But cake crumbs stay all week.
That night, it gets very cold. Grandma looks out the window.
First frost tonight. Bring your water bowls inside, everyone.
But Max's water bowl stays out in the garden all night.
And in the morning, something very strange happens to it.

long.title: 1 Birthday Cake, 5 Plates... Then a Knock! 🎂🐶
long.description:
"I'm the Chief Cake Sharer. Every piece has to be the same!" 🐱
It's Dog's birthday and Max must share one round cake fairly, but straight lines don't work on a circle, and then someone knocks at the door. Max the Curious Cat, Ep 33.
